rules.accepted_credit_types: Contact hours of nursing CE (1 CME = 1 contact hour; 10 contact hours = 1 CEU or 1 quarter hour; 15 = 1 semester hour); CE earned for another regulated profession does not count
rules.audit_note: Random audits by the Board; keep original certificates for at least 2 renewal cycles. CE completed after Dec 31 of the renewal year costs $50 per contact hour.

topics.who: APRNs with prescriptive authority: pharmacotherapy related to scope of practice, itemized on the certificate (UpToDate certificates not accepted); these hours also fulfill the 12-hour RN requirement

rules.notes: Base requirement is the 12 contact hours for the RN license; APRNs with prescriptive authority need 15 pharmacotherapy hours instead. Also 400 practice hours in 4 years. Fees: APRN $220, APRN with Rx authority $295 (compact RN: $80 / $155).
